title: Countable tensor preservation and the induced signed total tensor structures
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. Tensor preserves countable coproducts if for every countable set $I$ and every $X$, both $X\otimes-$ and $-\otimes X$ preserve colimits of $I$-indexed discrete diagrams [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], including the empty diagram. For an abelian $\mathcal C$ [def-sp-abelian] whose tensor is additive in both variables, having countable coproducts preserved by tensor in this sense, equip integer cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with the standard signed direct-sum total tensor [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso], the tensor unit in degree zero, and the standard associator and unitors induced by the coefficient constraints and reindexing the sums. These are the Mathlib graded totalization structures. If the base category has a braiding, use the Koszul braiding, whose $(p,q)$ summand map is $(-1)^{pq}$ times the base braiding into the $(q,p)$ summand.
